item.tib: mdo dri med kun gsal nas sman lha'i dkyil 'khor cho ga
mdo dri med kun gsal las sman lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga
item.coloph: sman lha'i rgyud rim ni/ dang po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa gshen rab mi bo (bo'i) zhal nas gsungs/ des dpyad bu khri shes la sogs nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la brgyud/ des dmu tsha tra he la sogs mkhas pa'i rgyan drug la brgyud/ des zhang zhung lho phyogs nyang stod gtsang po nu ma brag la/ dom sgro nag po ru bcug nas sbas so/ de nas las dang skal ba ldan pa'i/ ye shes dbal mo (mo'i) spral pa 'ol dkar gcig gis lung bstan nas/ khye'u gnyen mthing gi gter zhal phyes nas brgyud do/ des bla ma zhang ston lhun grub rgyal po la bka' babs/ khams lung nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ zhang sngags 'chang g.yung drung la brgyud/ zhang sngags spa sangs rdo rje la brgyud/ zhang sngags zla ba rdo rje la brgyud/ zhang sngags rin chen bstan 'dzin nas rim par brgyad nas/ ti shu 'od zer rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ des rgyal tshab g.yung drung bstan dbang la brgyud/ drang srong bsam gtan nyi ma la brgyud/ rtogs ldan shes rab dbang rgyal la brgyud do//

item.tib: mdo dri med kun gsal las sman lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga
